Though he humble himself and go crouching: he's nice to you, you got that promotion you wanted, you got that house at a discount; yet take good heed and beware of him. Thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away; the rust represents his wickedness, it's still there. Set him not by thee, lest when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place: that's what happened historically. We set them by us at the end of the dark ages, and they conquered us and took our place as Jews and Christians.
precepts.point: Though he spare it and forsake it not: it's still there. You go, no, he or she's not like that, I know them, these is good white folks, I just got a promotion, they helped me get a discount on a new car. It is still there.

note.label: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.why:
Job 20:12-13 says “Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue; Though he spare it, and forsake it not”. This white man loves wickedness, and he hid it for almost sixty years. From the civil rights era up until this new administration, you saw a new America: they loved black and brown people, we got jobs, we reached the heights of government, even President Barack Hussein Obama. Then the new administration came in and said, you're fired, you're fired. DEI, get out. Affirmative action, no more. Howard University dropped 52 incoming freshmen, and over 3,000 black women in high-ranking positions were fired. This is not a new America; it's the old America coming back.

So God says, “Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” It will surely come to pass. “Though he humble himself, and go crouching”: he's nice to you, you got the promotion you wanted, you got that house at a discount, they helped you get a discount on a new car. You say, no, these are good white folks, I know them. “yet take good heed and beware of him”.

“and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.” The rust represents his wickedness. It's still there, kept still within his mouth, just as Job says.

“Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place”. That is what happened historically. We set them by us at the end of the dark ages, and they conquered us and took our place as the Jews and the Christians. Even the records show it: the Arab historians and geographers, who were black Jews that spoke Arabic, wrote of black Jewish communities in Africa, the land of the Hebrews between Abyssinia and Congo and the Jews on both sides of the river Niger, and Esau asked, is this real or imagined, and wrote them down as imagined. He stood up in our place.

precepts.text: Now it gives a name to this wicked man: never trust thine enemy. But in order to understand this, you must be able to identify who the enemy is. You know what black people do? You're my enemy, you're my enemy. They'll never look at their oppressor and say that white man enslaved us, that's the enemy. Though he humble himself and go crouching: he's nice to you today; they smile with that plastic smile in your face. The white man gave me a raise. That don't mean nothing; they had a budget. Affirmative action? They get rid of that too, thanks to that negro Clarence Thomas. He became a judge based on affirmative action; now he getting rid of that thing. He said, I made mine, now I'm ending it. Thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away: like a looking glass covered with dust that you wipe; now you can see through the glass. That wickedness from verse 10 is still with him. Set him not by thee, lest when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place: that's what we did. The black Jews wanted to fight against the Muslims; we went to the Caucasus Mountains and said, we need the help of the Khazars. Those are the wildlings, by the way, in Game of Thrones. They converted to Judaism, they joined our army, we set them by us all over through our military. Now he's the Jew and you're the Gentile; he's the Christian and you're the Gentile. That's what happened. Neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat: you ever notice when black people get in business with white folks, it'll be the black man's business, and for some reason the white man take that thing over? Remember that Edomite that had a steakhouse getting no business, and the old black dude, Tenderism, made that thing booming; a brother helped him and got it all copyrighted. Don't trust these white folks. Y'all be like, he's different, he's not like the rest. Yeah, right. And thou at the last remember my words: when they tell you to put your teeth on the curb, like American History X, now you're going to remember God's words.
precepts.point: Though he spare it and forsake it not: meaning it's still there. But keep it still within his mouth.

“Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”. He's nice to you today; they smile that plastic smile in your face. The wickedness of verse 10 is still with him.

They converted to Judaism, joined our army, and we set them by us all through our military. Now he's the Jew and you're the Gentile; he's the Christian and you're the Gentile.

precepts.text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: space travel. They did not put their flag on the moon for anybody but themselves. I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north: the sides of the north is where we were taken. I will be like the most High: I will be like God.
precepts.point: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
precepts.why:
Job 20:6 says of the wicked, “Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds”. That is space travel and planes, and Isaiah 14 shows the same man. What Job's friend Zophar says here is prophetic.

“For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”. That is space travel. I will exalt my throne: see the American flag. They didn't put their flag on the moon for Africans or for Latinos. That's for America.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: that is slavery in North America, the sides of the north where we were taken. “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: that is planes. “I will be like the most High”: I'll be like God.

So when Job 20 says his excellency mounts up to the heavens and his head reaches the clouds, it is this man who said in his heart he would ascend into heaven and be like the Most High. And it goes on: “Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?” When God destroys this man, this hypocrite, all his ascending will not save him.

precepts.text: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it. Who spoke it? The Lord spoke that thing; we did not say it. Israelites who purposely ignore these scriptures and only read love scriptures are trying to change the narrative of what God is saying.
precepts.point: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
precepts.why:
Job 20 says of the wicked man, “He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.” Imagine it: this man is going to be like a dream when he is taken off the earth. Another name for a vision of the night is a nightmare. Dealing under this white man, God said, when you wake up it's going to be like a nightmare was chased away, and you are going to look for that man and he's going to be gone. “The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.”

He is going to be off the earth, and Obadiah says how: “And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.”

Who spoke it? The Lord hath spoken it. That ain't what we said; the Lord spoke that thing. Many Israelites are becoming like Israelite Christians: scriptures like this, and like what we are reading in Job, they purposely ignore, and say, no, we're just going to read the love scriptures, find the scriptures where all the nations are there. They try to change the narrative of what God is saying. But God says there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau.

And then “His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.” So don't worry about reparations. Everything this white man took from us, his hands shall restore. The Vatican holds a lot of gold, silver, and all our records: we are going to get everything back.

precepts.text: Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness. Though he humble himself, and go crouching: images were shown from 2020 of officials and crowds kneeling, hugging, and weeping before our people, and many said, see, they love us. Yet take good heed and beware of him: thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a looking glass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away. The wickedness is still there. Even the apology and the kissing of feet means nothing without restitution: if I steal your wallet and apologize, I give you your wallet back.
precepts.point: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God: that is the portion of Esau. His heritage is destruction.
precepts.why:
“Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue”. When we got our little civil rights, there were certain things the white man could not say no more. He had to watch the name calling; he had to give us jobs. So he hid the wickedness under his tongue. But now he's not hiding it no more: all you immigrants get out of our country, the Haitians out, the name calling, DEI, it's all ending now.

Sirach is the precept: “Never trust thine enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness. Though he humble himself, and go crouching”. That is him bowing down to you. Remember in DC, the police and white folks bowing to Black Lives Matter, hugging, kissing and crying, and a lot of blacks and Latinos said, see, they love us, they're humbling themselves to us. The Pope apologized for slavery and kissed feet, and the Africans said, he loves us. But did the Vatican not steal all the wealth from us and keep our records secret? Are they giving the wealth back? An apology means nothing without restitution. If I steal your wallet and I'm apologizing, I give you your wallet back.

“yet take good heed and beware of him, and thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass”. You ever see a dirty glass and you wipe it so you can see? God says that is how that white man is: wipe the looking glass so you can see clear, “and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.” The rust is still there. The wickedness is still there. God is saying, don't be deceived.

Job says the same thing: “Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth”. It's still there. Kramer from Seinfeld, a show our people loved and laughed through, went on a frenzy cursing black people out, that forty years ago you were hanging from a tree. The wickedness was under his tongue the whole time. They hate our guts.

precepts.text: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms? That is what they will say in that day.
precepts.point: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God: that is the portion of Esau. His heritage is destruction.
precepts.why:
Job 20:22 says, “In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.” Watch Isaiah 14: “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”. That is what they are going to say in that day about the man who shook the kingdoms of the earth.

And this is important, because there are black Hebrew Israelites saying we are going to commit this wickedness. But what did it say? Every hand of the wicked. This is proof that we are not going to be doing this. It is the other nations that are going to attack America for the atrocities, for all the bombings, for all the displacement. They attack us as though we are the problem, and they don't realize the Most High is going to raise up the other nations to come against them, and they are going to entreat them very, very bad. Every hand of the wicked shall do this, not us walking in righteousness.

Then “When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him”: when they shall say peace and safety, then sudden destruction.

precepts.text: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place: when Christ returns, the earth moves off her axis. And it shall be as the chased roe: a roe is a deer; they shall be as a sheep that no man taketh up, and they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land. Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword: those joined to them get the same judgment. The scripture says the invaders show no pity in that day, not even to the children. Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it: they do not care about the money. And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
precepts.point: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God: that is the portion of Esau. His heritage is destruction.
precepts.why:
Isaiah 13 tells what is going to happen to the man they look narrowly upon. “Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place”: when Christ returns, the earth is going to move off her axis, “in the wrath of the Lord of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.”

“And it shall be as the chased roe”: the Edomite shall be as a chased roe, and a roe is a deer; “and as a sheep that no man taketh up”, a sheep that nobody tries to save. “they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land. Every one that is found shall be thrust through”: every Edomite that is found. “and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword”: you want to keep your little Edomite friends? You are going to get it too. The nations ain't going to play.

“Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes”: the little hybrid babies, the little mixed kids. No mercy. “their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.”

“Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: that's over in Iran and Kurdistan, “which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” We don't care about your money, America, your 300 billion; they want revenge. “Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.”

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”: Babylon is the United States of America, the best country on the planet, and it “shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” That is Job 20:22, every hand of the wicked coming upon him, and Job 20:29: “This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.” That is the portion of the white man, of Esau, Edom: his heritage is destruction.

precepts.text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits; every hand of the wicked shall come upon him, as Habakkuk 2 and Revelation 17 when NATO turns; when he is about to fill his belly God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him and rain it upon him while he is eating. Same as Thessalonians. They try to make us the bad guys, but the real bad guys are written in the Bible, and their friends will turn on them.
precepts.point: When thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled, and when thou makest an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee. God will let the nations rise up.
precepts.why:
“In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits”. When he is full, because he did all the destruction and robbed the nations, he shall be in straits, meaning he is going to catch hell. This is talking about the same thing as Isaiah 33:1.

“every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.” We read that in Habakkuk 2, where all the remnant of the people shall spoil him, and you can read it in Revelation 17, when NATO turns on them, because it is going to happen.

“When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.” That is the same thing Thessalonians said: when they say peace and safety, sudden destruction.

They are trying to make it look like we are the bad guys. But the real bad guys are written in the Bible, and it is the people they are friends with now, the other nations and their own people, that are going to turn on them and attack them. The Lord told us to wait upon him till the day that he rises up. We trust in our God.

precepts.text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through; the glittering sword cometh out of his gall. The iron weapon and bow of steel are ballistic and nuclear missiles, glittering as they fly. The heaven shall reveal his iniquity, which the Lord is doing now, and the earth shall rise up against him: all the kings of the earth will rise against America and Israel because of the oppression.
precepts.point: Every move he makes is to buy time and prolong his rule, because in his mind this house goes on forever. Make sure the Arabs never come together, make sure Iran never gets nuclear capability, bomb them. And once he finishes with the nations he comes for us, the leaders in IUIC, to stop us prophesying and testifying, because once we testify, judgment comes. The laws are already being put in place.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
This explains the woe to the inhabiters of the earth. “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” He is America. The iron weapon is the missile, ballistic missiles, nuclear missiles, and the bow of steel is nuclear weapons. “It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall”: it is called a glittering sword because that is what the missiles look like when they are shooting.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”. That is what you are seeing right now: the Lord is revealing the wickedness America is doing on the earth. “and the earth shall rise up against him.” The high ones on high will be oppressing the nations on the earth; they will oppress Iran, they will oppress Saudi Arabia, they will oppress all nations, and even Europe is going to get it too. And as they do that, all the kings of the earth are going to rise up against America and Israel because of that oppression.

What you see now is the beginning, and it is going to get worse. Many are hailing Iran for shooting missiles, but America could drop one of its crazy bombs, not even the nuclear one, and Iran would be done. Yet Iran will not be fully taken out, and there will be no regime change. The people of Iran will hate America even more; there will be a truce, not peace, after America bombs their nuclear sites, and according to prophecy they will rebuild it all. The powers that be think they are buying time, but the Lord is behind all of it.

That is the great wrath of Revelation 12:12. The devil comes down on the inhabiters of the earth because he knows his time is short. Every move he makes is to buy time and prolong his rule, because in his mind his house will go on forever: make sure the Arabs never come together, make sure Iran never gets nuclear capability, and bomb them. And once he finishes with the nations he is coming for us, the leaders in IUIC, to stop us from prophesying and testifying, because when we testify against him, judgment comes. They are already putting the laws in place.

precepts.text: Hell from beneath is moved for thee, it stirreth up the dead, all the chief ones of the earth and the kings of the nations, and they say, Art thou also become weak as we? How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning, cut down to the ground. The nations rising up to destroy this place.
precepts.point: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity: as we teach, the angels make things happen until the whole world sees America and Israel as the oppressor. And the earth shall rise up against him.

note.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

precepts.why:
Job 20 is talking about America being destroyed: “a fire not blown shall consume him”, the nuclear bomb that needs no fanning to burn; “it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”, left here in America. “The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”: as we teach the word of God, the angels make things happen, Europe starts showing America's shame, and everybody sees America, and Israel too, as the oppressor. Europe has already brought charges against Netanyahu and put out a warrant for his arrest for war crimes. “and the earth shall rise up against him.”

Who is the earth that shall rise up against him? The nations. Isaiah explains it: “Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” Hell is the low condition everybody on earth is in under him. Raised up from their thrones: all the nations rising up to fight against America and destroy America.

“All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?”

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!” How are you fallen from ruling, O America. That is the earth rising up against him: the nations he weakened rising up to destroy this place.

precepts.text: He hath oppressed the poor and violently taken away an house which he builded not.
precepts.point: They covet fields and take them by violence, as with the oil of Nigeria and Venezuela and the land taken from Black towns in the South.
precepts.why:
Micah says, “And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” They covet the oil in Nigeria and Venezuela, the diamonds and copper in all the African countries, and take them by violence. America was built by violence: this is stolen land, and millions of indigenous people died for it. After they killed, murdered and raped, they built churches and said, God so loved the world.

Job describes the same man: “Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not”. Esau has oppressed, and we are the poor.

He violently took away houses he did not build. In the South, in Georgia, they drove whole black communities out of places like Lake Lanier and Forsyth and took the houses and businesses they never worked for, and they are still finding ways to take land that has been in black families for a century. When Esau came into Africa, King Leopold killed millions of our people, and the beauty of Europe was paid for with that. It is still happening: the wars in Sudan and the Congo, the minerals in the iPhone in your hand. He throws the rock and hides his hand, then says, black people killing black people. But black people don't make the weapons.

The dumb Christian says it was a long time ago. But every September 11 they want a moment of silence. It is not a long time ago; he is still violently taking away houses he builded not.

precepts.text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
precepts.point: The triumphing of the wicked is short and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment.
precepts.why:
Here is more about Esau: “Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth, That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?” Triumphing means victory: the victory of the wicked is short. America is the biggest hypocrite on planet earth, and its joy is but for a moment. This is temporary; there is going to be an end to it. All we have to do is be patient and wait.

And how does it end? “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” The iron weapon is the missile.

It goes with what was read in Isaiah 54: “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” The smith of old is what is called a scientist today, who makes weapons, and the waster is nuclear power. God let him create the waster to destroy, and the same weapons he made will strike him through.

So do not be joined to him. Isaiah says, “every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.” Everyone found married to these demons and having kids by them shall be thrust through, and many of our people will fall into that. Do not feel sorry for them. The triumphing of the wicked is short.

note.label: Psalm 37: Fret Not Because of Evildoers

precepts.why:
“For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.” Job says the same: “the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment”. “Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds; Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he? He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.”

These wicked people running this earth are not going to be here forever. A time will come when they are gone for ever, and we will wake up as from a bad dream, hardly believing our slave was ruler over a whole country.

So “Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him”. Everything happens on the Most High's time. You may not get it right now because you are not ready for it. Sisters and brothers may be asking for a husband or wife, but if you are not ready he will make you wait; wait for it and you may come out with a beautiful marriage, but be impatient and you get a back door marriage, because you are not trusting in him. Whenever we do something outside the counsel given by godly men, we are not trusting in the Most High.

“For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.” We put the Most High through drama to give this earth away, so we have to go through some drama to get it back.

moments.label: Cyber Warfare: The Mouth Of The Beast

points: His hands shall restore their goods. Shall restore all goods, cause they'll be servants. Shout out to Captain Yanathon. All praises.

Strange Fruit, sung by Billie Holiday in 1939. We're reading a lot of history in the — we just read 1933. He said, oh, mobs ain't killing people like they used to, even though they were still some. It's still happening today. Their wickedness has not changed. It's still within them.

This white man, his bones are filled with the sins of his youth. You could go back to 1776, but more importantly go back to Cain: God said Cain would be a fugitive and a vagabond, talking about his descendants. A fugitive is somebody always running from justice. The white man has never been judged yet. Even Netanyahu: the ICC put out a warrant for Netanyahu's arrest, and Trump said Netanyahu has nothing to fear; we don't give a damn what the International Court of Justice says.

points: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, meaning he loves wickedness. Though he hide it under his tongue: he hid that wickedness for almost 60 years. From the civil rights era up until this new administration, you saw a new America. They love black and brown people. We got jobs, we reached to the heights of government, you even had President Barack Hussein Obama: oh, he's our Moses. The new administration came in and said, you're fired, you're fired, you're fired. DEI, get the hell out. Affirmative action, no more. What's great for them is bad for us.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

points: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment: we have to believe that thing. This is Zophar speaking, but it is prophetic.
Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds: that goes back to Obadiah 4, space travel and planes.

Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he? He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night. Another name for a vision of the night is a nightmare. Dealing under this rule, God said when you wake up it is going to be like a nightmare was chased away, and you will look for that man and he will be gone. The eye also which saw him shall see him no more.

His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods: so do not worry about begging for reparations. Everything that was taken from us, the Bible says his hands shall restore. Think of the wealth, the gold, and our records held in the Vatican: we are going to get everything back.
His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue. Two explanations, both correct. When we got those little civil rights, there were certain things the white man could not say any more: he had to watch the name calling, he had to give us jobs. He hid the wickedness under his tongue. But now he is not hiding it any more: the immigrants are told to get out, the old words are coming back, the programs are ended.
Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth: it is still there. Job is saying the same thing Ecclesiasticus says.
Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him: it is poison within him.

He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly. That is reparations, that is restitution. Wherever they have it hidden, God said, I am going to bring up all the wealth they stole.
He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter: verse 17 is saying he is not going to enjoy the kingdom of heaven.

That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be. So while you are in the street crying for reparations, God says, do not worry about it: I have got you. Everything they took from us is coming back. And he shall not rejoice therein: he will not be happy about it, and God does not care. Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not: he took houses, lands, and people violently.

Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly: he shall not save of that which he desired. There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods: because it is all coming to us.

In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him. And this is important: it says every hand of the wicked, because there are Israelites saying we are going to execute this. No. It is the other nations that are going to attack America for the atrocities, for the bombings, for the displacement. The Most High is going to raise up the other nations against them; we walk in righteousness.

When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating: when they shall say, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction, 1 Thessalonians 5.

He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through: the iron weapon is the missiles. It is drawn, and cometh out of the body: it comes out of the body of the earth, the silos. Yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
A fire not blown shall consume him: when you light a fire you blow it to make it grow; nuclear fire you do not blow on, it grows of its own.
The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him. The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God: that is the portion of Esau. His heritage is destruction.

This goes into the restitution. That which he laboured for shall he restore: everything the white man is laboring for, all that gold and wealth they are storing up on the earth, the Most High says he is going to restore it. And shall not swallow it down: he is not going to enjoy it. According to his substance shall the restitution be: all the gold and pearls and rubies and diamonds. That is going to be our restitution. When Christ returns, all the wealth the white man has, he has to give it up.

Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not. This is what the white man did: he violently took away people's houses that he never built. So the restitution for stealing people's houses and lands is that you give up everything you have.
Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly: you are not going to be at peace. He shall not save of that which he desired: all that riches, you are not going to be able to save it for yourself.
Every hand of the wicked shall come upon him: that is what is going to happen to America. Saudi Arabia, Russia, Persia which is Iran, China.

Knowest thou not that the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment? It seems long, but the Bible says short. Though his excellency mount up to the heavens and his head reach the clouds, the one flying planes and travelling space, he shall perish for ever like his own dung.

They which have seen him shall say, Where is he? He shall fly away as a dream and be chased away as a vision of the night, a nightmare you wake up from. His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods: the Bible already prophesied reparations, so do not worry about them.

His bones are full of the sin of his youth, all the way back to Cain, not just 1776. Wickedness is sweet in his mouth and he hides it under his tongue: the president and first lady drawn as monkeys, and no apology, and never believe their apologies when they come.

Though he spare it and forsake it not: he spared his wickedness for sixty years, from civil rights in 1965 until now, and we squandered the time we had to organize the twelve tribes. Now the mask comes off, Black History Month goes, and he shows you he is the devil. The Most High is allowing it because we played games.

He hath swallowed down riches and he shall vomit them up again; God shall cast them out of his belly. He shall not see the rivers of honey and butter, the kingdom; he will be a servant there. That which he laboured for shall he restore according to his substance, and restitution is another word for reparations, and he shall not rejoice therein because he oppressed and forsook the poor and took away houses he did not build. Negroes built the White House.

When he is about to fill his belly, when they say peace and safety, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him while he is eating. He shall flee from the iron weapon, the intercontinental ballistic missile, and the bow of steel shall strike him through. A fire not blown, nuclear fire, shall consume him; whoever is left in his tabernacle, the USA, it shall go ill with him; and the heaven shall reveal his iniquity and the earth rise up against him. This is the portion of a wicked man from God.

He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through; terrors are upon him; a fire not blown, nuclear fire that needs no fanning, shall consume him, and it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle, America.
